USB_TOKEN.name: USB token
USB_TOKEN.description: Plug the token into this computer and enter the PIN. Signing software must be installed.
USB_TOKEN.description_certified: Plug the token into this computer and enter the PIN. Certificate: {{holder}}, expires {{expiry}}.

VNPT_SMARTCA.name: VNPT SmartCA
VNPT_SMARTCA.description_certified: Confirm in the phone app. Certificate: {{holder}}, expires {{expiry}}.

VIETTEL_MYSIGN.name: Viettel MySign
VIETTEL_MYSIGN.description_certified: Confirm in the phone app. Certificate: {{holder}}, expires {{expiry}}.

IMAGE.name: Signature image
IMAGE.description: Draw a signature image on the page. There is no digital signature, so it cannot be verified.
IMAGE.blocked: Not available for this contract: it only draws an image on the page, carries no digital signature, has no legal value and cannot be verified.

errors.NOT_YOUR_TURN: It is not your turn to sign.
errors.IMAGE_NOT_ALLOWED: This contract requires a digital signature; a signature image cannot be used.
errors.SIGNING_ALREADY_STARTED: Someone has already signed, so this can no longer be changed.
errors.UNKNOWN: That did not work. Please try again.

positions.title: Assign a signature slot to each step
positions.hint: Click an empty area to place a slot, or drag to draw one. Drag a slot to move it, drag the bottom-right corner to resize.

slot.aria: Signature slot {{stepNo}}, {{party}}. Use the arrow keys to move, Shift plus arrow to resize, Delete to remove.

list.title: Signature slots
list.position: Page {{page}} · {{top}} mm from top, {{left}} mm from left · size {{width}}×{{height}} mm
list.empty: No slot yet. Select this step, then click or drag on the PDF page.

tip.label: Tip:
tip.body: select a slot, then use the arrow keys to move, Shift + arrow to resize, Delete to remove. If you change the file, slots must be placed again.

checks.title: Checks before continuing
checks.ONE_SLOT_PER_STEP: Every signing step has exactly one slot.
checks.NO_OVERLAP: The two slots do not overlap.
checks.NO_CONTENT_COVERED: A slot does not cover clause text or a signer name.

source.title: Source text in the PDF
source.hint: Yellow areas are where the system read out figures. Click a row on the right to see where it came from.

clause.TOTAL_VALUE: The total contract value is <mark>{{value}}</mark>, paid in {{milestones}} milestones.
clause.LATE_PENALTY: Late delivery is penalised at <mark>{{rate}}% of the milestone value per day</mark>, with a total penalty of no more than <mark>{{cap}}% of the milestone value</mark>.
clause.APPROVALS: Each payment needs the approval of <mark>{{approvers}} buyer role(s)</mark>.

ambiguity.title: MS{{no}}: the contract only says "after {{months}} months of warranty"
ambiguity.body: There is no specific date, so the system cannot work it out. Enter a due date, or leave it empty and this milestone stays on HOLD until a date is known.
ambiguity.label: MS{{no}} due date

approvers.title: Approvers named in the contract
approvers.note_one: {{count}} approval role is needed per milestone.
approvers.note_other: {{count}} approval roles are needed per milestone.

total.title: Sum of milestones
total.match: Matches the contract value in Article {{article}}.
total.mismatch: Does not match the contract value ({{value}} million VND).

footer.lockNote: Once confirmed, the digitised terms are locked. To change them, create a new version and sign again.
footer.locked: The digitised terms are confirmed and locked.
footer.confirm: Confirm digitised terms and continue to signing

description.intermediate: {{role}}, {{organization}}. Signs with a digital signature backed by a valid certificate.
description.final: {{organization}}. This is the last step and needs a digital signature; a signature image is not allowed.

note.notifyNext: After you sign, the system notifies this person.
note.queued: The system notifies this person when it is their turn.
note.awaiting: The system is waiting for this person to sign.

rules.title: Sequence rules
rules.turn: Only the person whose turn it is can sign. Everyone else can only view.
rules.lock: The file cannot be edited after the first signature.
rules.cancel: A signing request can only be cancelled while nobody has signed.

idle.title: Signing request not sent
idle.description: Choose a method, then send the signing request.

CANCELLED.title: The signing request was cancelled
CANCELLED.description: You cancelled the request. Send it again when you are ready.

REJECTED.title: The request was rejected on the phone
REJECTED.description: Send the request again if you want to keep signing.

EXPIRED.title: The request has expired
EXPIRED.description: Send the request again to get a new confirmation code.

sent.title: Signing request sent
sent.REMOTE: The request has reached the app on your phone.
sent.USB: The request has reached the signing software on this computer.

REMOTE.title: Waiting for you to confirm on your phone
REMOTE.description: Sent to the {{app}} app at {{time}}. {{remaining}} left before the request expires. Check that the confirmation code on your phone matches {{code}}.

USB.title: Waiting for you to enter the PIN on the token
USB.description: Sent to the signing software at {{time}}. {{remaining}} left before the request expires.

done.title: Done
done.description: Your signature is recorded in the contract and the {{nextParty}} is notified that it is their turn.
done.descriptionFinal: Your signature is recorded in the contract, which now has every signature and is in force.

lock.title: The file is locked while you wait
lock.body: Nobody can upload a new file or change the signature positions. Click "Cancel request" to unlock it. If something goes wrong, see signing exceptions.

phone.caption:
Screen on the signer's phone
(the certificate provider's app, outside this system)
phone.title: Digital signing request
phone.codeLabel: Confirmation code, must match the computer screen
phone.idle: No signing request has been sent to this phone.

EFFECTIVE.title: The contract has every signature and is in force from {{dateTime}}
EFFECTIVE.body_one: Both parties have signed. The system has opened {{count}} payment milestone to start tracking.
EFFECTIVE.body_other: Both parties have signed. The system has opened {{count}} payment milestones to start tracking.

INCOMPLETE.title: The contract does not have every signature yet
INCOMPLETE.body: Only {{signed}} of {{total}} valid signatures are in the file.

check.title: Check any file
check.description: Third parties, auditors or partners drop a PDF here to see whether the signatures still hold, without signing in to the contract.
check.dropzone: Drop a PDF here or choose a file
check.aria: Choose a PDF file to check

result.VALID_one: Found {{count}} signature in the file; the content has not changed since signing.
result.VALID_other: Found {{count}} signatures in the file; the content has not changed since signing.
result.NO_SIGNATURE: This file has no digital signature.
result.NOT_PDF: This is not a PDF file.
result.UNVERIFIED: Signature structure detected; cryptographic signature and certificate have not been verified.

invalid.title: When the result reports invalid

reasons.CONTENT_EDITED: The file content was edited after signing, even by one character.
reasons.WRONG_SIGNER: The signer is not the person assigned to that step.
reasons.CERT_REVOKED: The certificate was revoked, or expired before the signing time.

invalid.exceptions: See the screen for each exception
